releaseNotes: - Complete Material 3 Expressive UI refresh across app screens, settings, dialogs, widgets, icons, typography, animations, banners, and loading states.
- Add top-tabs navigation with swipe support, ViewPager2 migration, and immediate theme/navigation refresh.
- Improve profile widget styling, launcher shortcut icons, adaptive app icon support, and settings layout consistency.
- Improve startup and page-loading stability, including fixes for checking-info flow and navigation page selection.
- Improve battery, voltage, and dynamic CPU hotplug detection, including single-cluster CPU voltage support.
- Fix disable charging and MIN/MAX store mode controls so supported sysfs nodes are detected and applied dynamically.
